posts.body: The Eagles' top two receivers -- DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks -- have been ruled out of Monday night's game against the Cowboys.

posts.headline: Packers activate RB Josh Jacobs for 2026 debut
posts.body: Packers running back Josh Jacobs will make his 2026 season debut against the Lions after spending the first six weeks on the NFL's commissioner exempt list.
